The pole is a pure band detector on GELU's minimum with no stable feature: it fires wherever the layer-1 pre-activation happens to land near -0.75, so long abstract passages should reach the ceiling about as often as concrete ones and meaning should predict its peaks no better than chance.

The pole tracks the LayerNorm scale of the residual stream rather than content: it fires where the per-dimension spread of the layer-1 input is small, so short prompts and repeated common tokens should predict it better than concreteness or script does.
